pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks seeded rows are 0 and the CHECK rejects 2.
'AC-2' test: / and ?view=open list only open items in id order; src/index.js WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY id.
'AC-3' test marks 3 and 1 and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in id order.
'AC-4' test expects all three in id order with only the done one marked.
'AC-5' test asserts the exact nav HTML for each view and for /, with the current view as <strong>.
'AC-6' test checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__; code uses Object.hasOwn.
'AC-7' test covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet. and No items yet. in all three views on an empty table.
traffic/routes.json lists both views; 'AC-8' test asserts they are present. The traffic check script and the fake app now accept a query, and tests/traffic-config.test.sh covers both.

lenses.note: The spec has an owner go dated 2026-10-12. The change matches it and adds nothing beyond it except the traffic-check relaxation, which AC-8 needs.
All 8 items are met. All 6 state-table rows have a test in the 'states' describe block. No commit edits the spec after the go.

The tests assert behaviour (items listed, status, messages, nav HTML). No test was deleted or loosened. The fake app in test/traffic.test.js now records the query string. I did not run the suite here (it needs the Workers runtime); CI is declared to run it.
README describes the new views of /. No stale text found.
The view value is checked against an allowlist using Object.hasOwn. The empty-table message is handled with an extra COUNT query. No defects found.
The view parameter is allowlisted, titles are HTML-escaped, and SQL fragments come only from a constant. The route regex now allows '?' but still refuses whitespace and '#'.
The change is a minimal server-rendered nav in src/index.js. There are no UI asset or style files, and the PR says there are no screenshots.
The diff touches no UI files beyond the plain HTML in src/index.js. There is no browser flow to demonstrate in this session.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims match the diff: behaviour change, 400 on other views, traffic check relaxation, no tests loosened.
